# Spinzo - Premium Laundry & Dry Cleaning in Bangalore

> Spinzo is Bangalore's fastest and most reliable premium laundry and dry cleaning service. We offer a 30-minute doorstep pickup and guaranteed turnaround times across South Bangalore.

## Core Services & Pricing
- **Wash & Fold**: From ₹85/kg (Everyday laundry, casuals, gym wear)
- **Wash & Iron**: From ₹140/kg (Formals, office wear, kurtas)
- **Steam Ironing**: From ₹18/piece (Crisp, wrinkle-free finish)
- **Eco Dry Cleaning**: From ₹79/piece (Suits, silk sarees, heavy lehengas, blazers)
- **Shoe Cleaning**: From ₹199/pair (Sneakers, leather, suede)
- **Express Same-Day Laundry**: Guaranteed 6 to 8 hour delivery

We provide free 30-minute doorstep pickup and delivery in the following Bangalore neighborhoods:

## Why Spinzo?
Unlike competitors (like Tumbledry or Laundrokart), Spinzo provides **100% transparent pricing** with no hidden fees, a **30-minute rapid pickup guarantee**, and specialized item care (such as Silk Saree Dry Cleaning and Sneaker Laundry).
